    <h2>{`Overview`}</h2>
    <p>{`Dialog components in Graphite provide powerful modal interaction patterns for user interfaces. These components enable you to present focused content, gather user input, and facilitate data selection without navigating away from the current context. This guide covers four essential dialog components that form the foundation of modal interactions in Graphite applications.`}</p>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`The Four Dialog Components:`}</strong></p>
    <ol>
      <li parentName="ol">
        <p parentName="li"><strong parentName="p">{`Dialog`}</strong>{` - A versatile modal window for displaying content with customizable action buttons and decorations. Perfect for confirmations, forms, and focused content presentation.`}</p>
      </li>
      <li parentName="ol">
        <p parentName="li"><strong parentName="p">{`Lookup`}</strong>{` - A specialized modal for searching and selecting items from a datasource. Supports both mobile list views and desktop table views with advanced features like barcode scanning, filtering, and multi-select.`}</p>
      </li>
      <li parentName="ol">
        <p parentName="li"><strong parentName="p">{`Lookup with Filter`}</strong>{` - An enhanced lookup component that provides a filter element for refining search results. This is driven by a `}<inlineCode parentName="p">{`datasource`}</inlineCode>{` where an attribute is flagged as `}<inlineCode parentName="p">{`filterable`}</inlineCode>{`. Also supports hierarchical data navigation for drill-down scenarios.`}</p>
      </li>
      <li parentName="ol">
        <p parentName="li"><strong parentName="p">{`Sliding Drawer`}</strong>{` - A side-panel modal that slides in from the start or end of the screen. Provides a non-intrusive way to display supplementary content while maintaining context with the main view.`}</p>
      </li>
    </ol>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Common Characteristics:`}</strong></p>
    <p>{`All dialog components in Graphite share several key characteristics:`}</p>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul">{`They must be declared within a `}<inlineCode parentName="li">{`<dialogs>`}</inlineCode>{` container element`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`They support controller binding for advanced behavior and lifecycle management`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`They provide event callbacks for open, close, and action events`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`They can be opened programmatically via `}<inlineCode parentName="li">{`page.showDialog()`}</inlineCode>{` or `}<inlineCode parentName="li">{`app.showDialog()`}</inlineCode></li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`They support validation callbacks to prevent closing with unsaved changes`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`They integrate seamlessly with Graphite’s state management and datasource system`}</li>
    </ul>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`When to Use Each Component:`}</strong></p>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Use `}<strong parentName="li">{`Dialog`}</strong>{` when you need a general-purpose modal for confirmations, alerts, or custom forms`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Use `}<strong parentName="li">{`Lookup`}</strong>{` when users need to search and select from a list of items with rich filtering and search capabilities`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Use `}<strong parentName="li">{`Lookup with Filter`}</strong>{` when you need advanced filtering capabilities driven by datasource attributes, or when working with hierarchical data that requires drill-down navigation`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Use `}<strong parentName="li">{`Sliding Drawer`}</strong>{` when you want to show supplementary content without completely blocking the main view`}</li>
    </ul>
    <hr></hr>
    <h2>{`Common Lifecycle Events`}</h2>
    <p>{`All dialog components support controller binding, allowing you to hook into key lifecycle moments and respond to user interactions. When you bind a controller to a dialog component, you can implement event handler methods that are automatically called at specific points in the component’s lifecycle.`}</p>
    <h3>{`Binding a Controller`}</h3>
    <p>{`To bind a controller to any dialog component, use the `}<inlineCode parentName="p">{`controller`}</inlineCode>{` attribute:`}</p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-xml"
      }}>{`<dialog id="myDialog" title="Sample Dialog" controller="MyDialogController">
  <!-- dialog content -->
</dialog>

<lookup id="myLookup" datasource="itemsDS" controller="MyLookupController">
  <!-- lookup configuration -->
</lookup>

<sliding-drawer id="myDrawer" header-text="Details" controller="MyDrawerController">
  <!-- drawer content -->
</sliding-drawer>
`}</code></pre>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-javascript"
      }}>{`// src/controllers/MyDialogController.js
export default class MyDialogController {
  // Implement lifecycle event handlers here
}
`}</code></pre>
    <h3>{`Shared Lifecycle Events`}</h3>
    <p>{`The following lifecycle events are available across all dialog components:`}</p>
    <h4>{`1. `}<inlineCode parentName="h4">{`on-open-action`}</inlineCode>{` Event`}</h4>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`When it fires:`}</strong>{` Immediately after the dialog/lookup/drawer opens and becomes visible to the user.`}</p>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Use this when you need to:`}</strong></p>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Initialize component state or load data when it opens`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Set focus on a specific field`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Log analytics events for views`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Perform setup that depends on the component being visible`}</li>
    </ul>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Event Handler Signature:`}</strong></p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-javascript"
      }}>{`onOpenAction(event) {
  // event contains the component context and any arguments passed via on-open-action-arg
}
`}</code></pre>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Example - Loading data when opening:`}</strong></p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-xml"
      }}>{`<dialog id="editDialog" 
        title="Edit Item" 
        controller="EditDialogController"
        on-open-action="loadItemData"
        on-open-action-arg="{item.id}">
  <field label="Name" value="{dialog.state.itemName}" />
</dialog>
`}</code></pre>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-javascript"
      }}>{`export default class EditDialogController {
  loadItemData(itemId) {
    // Fetch item details when dialog opens
    const datasource = this.dialog.findDatasource('itemDS');
    datasource.load({ id: itemId });
  }
}
`}</code></pre>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Common Scenarios:`}</strong></p>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Form initialization:`}</strong>{` Pre-populate form fields with existing data`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Dynamic content loading:`}</strong>{` Fetch data from an API when the component opens`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`User tracking:`}</strong>{` Record that a user opened a specific component for analytics`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Focus management:`}</strong>{` Set initial focus to the first input field`}</li>

    <hr></hr>
    <h4>{`2. `}<inlineCode parentName="h4">{`on-close-action`}</inlineCode>{` Event`}</h4>

    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Use this when you need to:`}</strong></p>

      <li parentName="ul">{`Perform cleanup operations`}</li>

    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Event Handler Signature:`}</strong></p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{

    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Example - Cleanup on close:`}</strong></p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{

    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{

    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Common Scenarios:`}</strong></p>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`State cleanup:`}</strong>{` Clear temporary state that was only needed while the component was open`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Resource release:`}</strong>{` Cancel pending API requests or timers`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Analytics:`}</strong>{` Track how users exit components (close vs. save)`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Validation reset:`}</strong>{` Clear validation errors when the component closes`}</li>

    <h4>{`3. `}<inlineCode parentName="h4">{`validate`}</inlineCode>{` Event`}</h4>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`When it fires:`}</strong>{` Before the component closes (via any method), allowing you to prevent closure if validation fails.`}</p>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Use this when you need to:`}</strong></p>

      <li parentName="ul">{`Check for unsaved changes and prompt the user`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Ensure required fields are filled`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Perform complex validation logic`}</li>
    </ul>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Event Handler Signature:`}</strong></p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{

    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Example - Comprehensive validation:`}</strong></p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-xml"
      }}>{`<dialog id="formDialog" 
        title="User Registration" 
        controller="FormDialogController"
        validate="validateForm"
        primary-action-text="Register">
  <field label="Email" value="{dialog.state.email}" />
  <field label="Password" value="{dialog.state.password}" />
</dialog>
`}</code></pre>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-javascript"
      }}>{`export default class FormDialogController {
  validateForm() {
    const { email, password } = this.dialog.state;
    
    // Email validation
    if (!email || !email.includes('@')) {
      this.app.toast('Please enter a valid email address');
      return false;
    }
    
    // Password validation
    if (!password || password.length < 8) {
      this.app.toast('Password must be at least 8 characters');
      return false;
    }
    
    // All validation passed
    return true;
  }
}
`}</code></pre>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Common Scenarios:`}</strong></p>

    <hr></hr>
    <h2>{`Programmatic Access`}</h2>
    <p>{`All dialog components can be opened and closed programmatically from controllers or event handlers. This provides flexibility for dynamic component management based on application logic.`}</p>
    <h3>{`Opening a Dialog Component`}</h3>
    <p>{`Use `}<inlineCode parentName="p">{`page.showDialog()`}</inlineCode>{` or `}<inlineCode parentName="p">{`app.showDialog()`}</inlineCode>{` to open any dialog component programmatically:`}</p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-javascript"
      }}>{`// From a page controller
export default class MyPageController {
  openEditDialog(item) {
    this.page.showDialog('editDialog', {
      item: item,
      mode: 'edit'
    });
  }
  
  openLookup() {
    this.page.showDialog('itemLookup', {
      preselectedValues: [1, 2, 3]
    });
  }
  
  openDrawer() {
    this.page.showDialog('detailsDrawer', {
      itemId: 123
    });
  }
}
`}</code></pre>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Method Signature:`}</strong></p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-javascript"
      }}>{`page.showDialog(componentId, options, context)
app.showDialog(componentId, options, context)
`}</code></pre>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Parameters:`}</strong></p>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul"><inlineCode parentName="li">{`componentId`}</inlineCode>{` (string): The ID of the component to open`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><inlineCode parentName="li">{`options`}</inlineCode>{` (object, optional): Options object passed to the component`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><inlineCode parentName="li">{`context`}</inlineCode>{` (object, optional): Additional context information`}</li>
    </ul>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Accessing Options in Controller:`}</strong></p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-javascript"
      }}>{`export default class MyComponentController {
  onOpenAction(options) {
    // Access the options passed to showDialog
    const item = options.item;
    const mode = options.mode;
    
    // Use the options to initialize component state
    this.dialog.state.currentItem = item;
    this.dialog.state.editMode = mode;
  }
}
`}</code></pre>
    <h3>{`Closing a Dialog Component`}</h3>
    <p>{`Close a component programmatically using the component instance:`}</p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-javascript"
      }}>{`export default class MyComponentController {
  cancelOperation() {
    // Close from within the controller
    // Works for dialog, lookup, and drawer
    this.dialog.closeDialog();
    // or
    this.lookup.closeDialog();
    // or
    this.drawer.closeDialog();
  }
}
`}</code></pre>
    <p>{`You can also close components from outside using the UserInteractionManager:`}</p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-javascript"
      }}>{`import UserInteractionManager from '@maximo/graphite-framework/util/UserInteractionManager';

// Close a specific component by ID
UserInteractionManager.get().closeDialog('myComponentId');
`}</code></pre>
    <h3>{`Finding a Dialog Component`}</h3>
    <p>{`Access a dialog instance from a page:`}</p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-javascript"
      }}>{`export default class MyPageController {
  getComponentState() {
    // Find the component by ID
    const dialog = this.page.findDialog('editDialog');
    
    // Access component state
    const currentState = dialog.state;
    
    return currentState;
  }
}
`}</code></pre>
    <h3>{`State Management`}</h3>
    <p>{`All dialog components support state management through the `}<inlineCode parentName="p">{`<state>`}</inlineCode>{` component:`}</p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-xml"
      }}>{`<dialog id="myDialog" title="Sample Dialog">
  <states>
    <state name="userName" type="string" value="" />
    <state name="userAge" type="number" value="0" />
    <state name="isValid" type="boolean" value="false" />
  </states>
  
  <field label="Name" value="{dialog.state.userName}" />
  <field label="Age" value="{dialog.state.userAge}" />
</dialog>
`}</code></pre>
    <p>{`Access and modify state from the controller:`}</p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-javascript"
      }}>{`export default class MyComponentController {
  onOpenAction() {
    // Read state
    const currentName = this.dialog.state.userName;
    
    // Update state
    this.dialog.state.userName = 'John Doe';
    this.dialog.state.userAge = 30;
    this.dialog.state.isValid = true;
  }
}
`}</code></pre>
    <hr></hr>
    <h2>{`Dialog Component`}</h2>
    <p>{`The Dialog component is the most versatile modal window in Graphite, providing a centered modal overlay with customizable content, action buttons, and window decorations.`}</p>
    <h3>{`Component-Specific Lifecycle Events`}</h3>
    <p>{`In addition to the common lifecycle events, Dialog supports these specific events:`}</p>
    <h4><inlineCode parentName="h4">{`on-primary-action`}</inlineCode>{` Event`}</h4>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`When it fires:`}</strong>{` When the user clicks the primary action button (typically “OK”, “Save”, “Submit”).`}</p>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Example:`}</strong></p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-xml"
      }}>{`<dialog id="createDialog" 
        title="Create New Item" 
        controller="CreateDialogController"
        primary-action-text="Create"
        on-primary-action="createItem">
  <field label="Name" value="{dialog.state.newItemName}" required="true" />
</dialog>
`}</code></pre>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-javascript"
      }}>{`export default class CreateDialogController {
  async createItem() {
    if (!this.dialog.state.newItemName) {
      this.app.toast('Name is required');
      return false; // Prevent dialog from closing
    }

    const datasource = this.page.findDatasource('itemsDS');
    await datasource.addNew({ name: this.dialog.state.newItemName });
    await datasource.save();
    
    return true; // Allow dialog to close
  }
}
`}</code></pre>
    <h4><inlineCode parentName="h4">{`on-secondary-action`}</inlineCode>{` Event`}</h4>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`When it fires:`}</strong>{` When the user clicks the secondary action button (typically “Cancel”, “Back”).`}</p>
    <h4><inlineCode parentName="h4">{`on-tertiary-action`}</inlineCode>{` Event`}</h4>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`When it fires:`}</strong>{` When the user clicks the tertiary action button (optional third button).`}</p>

    <h2>{`Lookup Component`}</h2>
    <p>{`The Lookup component is a specialized modal for searching and selecting items from a datasource. It supports both mobile list views and desktop table views with advanced features like barcode scanning, filtering, multi-select, and hierarchical drill-down navigation.`}</p>
    <h3>{`Component-Specific Lifecycle Events`}</h3>
    <p>{`In addition to common events, Lookup supports:`}</p>
    <h4><inlineCode parentName="h4">{`on-item-click`}</inlineCode>{` Event`}</h4>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`When it fires:`}</strong>{` When a user clicks on an item in the lookup list/table.`}</p>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Example:`}</strong></p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-xml"
      }}>{`<lookup id="itemLookup"
        datasource="itemsDS"
        controller="ItemLookupController"
        on-item-click="handleItemSelection"
        on-item-click-arg="{item}">
</lookup>
`}</code></pre>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-javascript"
      }}>{`export default class ItemLookupController {
  handleItemSelection(item) {
    console.log('Selected item:', item);
    // Process the selected item
    this.page.state.selectedItem = item;
  }
}
`}</code></pre>
    <h4><inlineCode parentName="h4">{`on-reset-action`}</inlineCode>{` Event`}</h4>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`When it fires:`}</strong>{` When the user clicks the “Clear changes” action.`}</p>

    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{

  <lookup id="assetLookup"
          datasource="assetsDS"
          lookup-heading="Select Asset"
          lookup-subheading="Choose from available assets"
          show-search="true"
          can-filter="true"
          can-sort="true"
          enable-barcode-scanner="true"
          lookup-attributes="{['assetnum', 'description', 'location']}"
          controller="AssetLookupController"
          on-primary-action="confirmSelection">
    <toolbar-actions>
      <button icon="carbon:add" label="Add New" on-click="addNewAsset" />
    </toolbar-actions>
  </lookup>
</dialogs>
`}</code></pre>
    <hr></hr>
    <h2>{`Lookup with Filter Component`}</h2>
    <p>{`The Lookup with Filter component is an enhanced lookup that provides a filter element for refining search results. This is driven by a `}<inlineCode parentName="p">{`datasource`}</inlineCode>{` where an attribute is flagged as `}<inlineCode parentName="p">{`filterable`}</inlineCode>{`. It also supports hierarchical data navigation with drill-down capabilities, making it ideal for complex data structures.`}</p>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Key Features:`}</strong></p>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Filter-driven search based on datasource attributes marked as `}<inlineCode parentName="li">{`filterable`}</inlineCode></li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Hierarchical drill-down navigation`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Supports both flat and tree-structured data`}</li>
    </ul>
    <h3>{`Component-Specific Lifecycle Events`}</h3>
    <p>{`In addition to common events, Lookup with Filter supports:`}</p>
    <h4><inlineCode parentName="h4">{`on-item-click`}</inlineCode>{` Event`}</h4>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`When it fires:`}</strong>{` When a user clicks on an item. In hierarchical mode, fires when the last child is selected.`}</p>
    <h4><inlineCode parentName="h4">{`on-drill-in`}</inlineCode>{` Event`}</h4>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`When it fires:`}</strong>{` When the datalist is initialized or the drill-in button is clicked.`}</p>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Event Arguments:`}</strong></p>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul"><inlineCode parentName="li">{`item`}</inlineCode>{`: The current item being drilled into (null/undefined for root level)`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Access to datasource and component state through controller`}</li>
    </ul>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Use Cases:`}</strong></p>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Loading hierarchical data dynamically`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Filtering child records based on parent selection`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Implementing lazy-loading for large datasets`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Building breadcrumb navigation`}</li>
    </ul>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Basic Example:`}</strong></p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-xml"
      }}>{`<lookup-with-filter id="locationLookup"
                    datasource="locationsDS"
                    hierarchy-drill-in="true"
                    controller="LocationLookupController"
                    on-drill-in="handleDrillIn"
                    on-drill-in-arg="{item}">
</lookup-with-filter>
`}</code></pre>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-javascript"
      }}>{`export default class LocationLookupController {
  handleDrillIn(item) {
    if (!item) {
      // Root level - load top-level locations
      this.loadRootLocations();
    } else {
      // Load children of the selected item
      this.loadChildLocations(item);
    }
  }
}
`}</code></pre>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Enabling Drill-Down`}</strong></p>
    <p>{`To enable drill down functionality, the datasource tied to the component must have an attribute designed to define the child relationship.`}</p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-xml"
      }}>{`<attribute name="assetchildren" child-relationship="assetchildren" id="w7d2z"/>
`}</code></pre>
    <p>{`The default behavior displays a chevron icon on the right side of each element that contains children.
`}<span parentName="p" {...{
        "className": "gatsby-resp-image-wrapper",
        "style": {
          "position": "relative",
          "display": "block",
          "marginLeft": "auto",
          "marginRight": "auto",
          "maxWidth": "822px"
        }
      }}>{`
      `}<span parentName="span" {...{
          "className": "gatsby-resp-image-background-image",
          "style": {
            "paddingBottom": "39.93055555555555%",
            "position": "relative",
            "bottom": "0",
            "left": "0",
            "backgroundImage": "url('data:image/png;base64,')",
            "backgroundSize": "cover",
            "display": "block"
          }
        }}></span>{`
  `}<img parentName="span" {...{
          "className": "gatsby-resp-image-image",
          "alt": "drill down no hierarchy",
          "title": "drill down no hierarchy",

    <h2>{`Sliding Drawer Component`}</h2>
    <p>{`The Sliding Drawer component provides a side-panel modal that slides in from the start or end of the screen. It’s perfect for displaying supplementary content while maintaining context with the main view.`}</p>

    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{

      }}>{`<dialogs>
  <sliding-drawer id="detailsDrawer"
                  header-text="Item Details"
                  sub-title="View and edit item information"
                  align="end"
                  content-padding="true"
                  dock-on-expand="true"
                  controller="DetailsDrawerController"
                  on-open-action="loadDetails">
    <box padding="2">
      <field label="Name" value="{drawer.state.itemName}" />
      <field label="Description" value="{drawer.state.itemDescription}" />
    </box>
    
    <button slot="primary-button" 
            label="Save" 
            on-click="saveDetails" />
    <button slot="secondary-button" 
            label="Cancel" 
            on-click="{drawer.closeDialog()}" />
  </sliding-drawer>
</dialogs>
`}</code></pre>
    <hr></hr>
    <h2>{`Best Practices`}</h2>
    <h3>{`1. Use Meaningful Component IDs`}</h3>
    <p>{`Choose descriptive IDs that clearly indicate the component’s purpose:`}</p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-xml"
      }}>{`<!-- Good -->
<dialog id="confirmDeleteDialog" title="Confirm Deletion">
<lookup id="assetSelectionLookup" datasource="assetsDS">
<sliding-drawer id="itemDetailsDrawer" header-text="Details">

<!-- Avoid -->
<dialog id="dlg1" title="Dialog">
<lookup id="l" datasource="ds">
`}</code></pre>
    <h3>{`2. Leverage State for Dynamic Content`}</h3>
    <p>{`Use component state instead of direct DOM manipulation:`}</p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-javascript"
      }}>{`// Good - Use state
this.dialog.state.errorMessage = 'Invalid input';
this.dialog.state.showError = true;

// Avoid - Direct DOM manipulation
document.getElementById('errorDiv').textContent = 'Invalid input';
`}</code></pre>
    <h3>{`3. Implement Proper Validation`}</h3>
    <p>{`Always validate user input before processing:`}</p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-javascript"
      }}>{`validate() {
  const requiredFields = ['name', 'email', 'phone'];
  
  for (const field of requiredFields) {
    if (!this.dialog.state[field]) {
      this.app.toast(\`\${field} is required\`);
      return false;
    }
  }
  
  return true;
}
`}</code></pre>
    <h3>{`4. Handle Async Operations Properly`}</h3>
    <p>{`Use `}<inlineCode parentName="p">{`async-primary-action`}</inlineCode>{` for asynchronous operations:`}</p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-xml"
      }}>{`<dialog id="saveDialog" 
        async-primary-action="true"
        on-primary-action="saveData">
`}</code></pre>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-javascript"
      }}>{`async saveData() {
  try {
    const datasource = this.page.findDatasource('itemsDS');
    await datasource.save();
    this.app.toast('Saved successfully');
    return true;
  } catch (error) {
    this.app.toast('Save failed: ' + error.message);
    return false; // Keep dialog open on error
  }
}
`}</code></pre>
    <h3>{`5. Clean Up Resources`}</h3>
    <p>{`Always clean up in the close handler:`}</p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-javascript"
      }}>{`onCloseAction() {
  // Clear temporary state
  this.dialog.state.tempData = null;
  
  // Cancel pending operations
  if (this.pendingRequest) {
    this.pendingRequest.abort();
  }
  
  // Reset form fields
  this.dialog.state.formData = {};
}
`}</code></pre>
    <h3>{`6. Choose the Right Component`}</h3>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Use `}<strong parentName="li">{`Dialog`}</strong>{` for simple confirmations and forms`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Use `}<strong parentName="li">{`Lookup`}</strong>{` when users need to search and select from flat data`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Use `}<strong parentName="li">{`Lookup with Filter`}</strong>{` for hierarchical data navigation`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Use `}<strong parentName="li">{`Sliding Drawer`}</strong>{` for supplementary content that doesn’t require full focus`}</li>
    </ul>
    <h3>{`7. Provide Clear Action Labels`}</h3>
    <p>{`Use action-oriented labels that describe what will happen:`}</p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-xml"
      }}>{`<!-- Good -->
<dialog primary-action-text="Save Changes" secondary-action-text="Cancel">
<lookup primary-action-text="Select Items" secondary-action-text="Cancel">

<!-- Avoid -->
<dialog primary-action-text="OK" secondary-action-text="No">
`}</code></pre>
    <h3>{`8. Consider Mobile vs Desktop`}</h3>
    <p>{`Use size and padding properties appropriately:`}</p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-xml"
      }}>{`<!-- Small dialog for simple confirmations -->
<dialog size="sm" title="Confirm">

<!-- Large lookup for complex selection -->
<lookup size="lg" datasource="itemsDS">

<!-- Drawer with proper padding -->
<sliding-drawer content-padding="true" header-text="Details">
`}</code></pre>
    <h3>{`9. Use Controllers for Complex Logic`}</h3>
    <p>{`Keep XML clean by moving logic to controllers:`}</p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-xml"
      }}>{`<!-- Good - Logic in controller -->
<dialog id="myDialog" 
        controller="MyDialogController"
        on-primary-action="handleSave">

<!-- Avoid - Inline logic -->
<dialog id="myDialog" 
        on-primary-action="{app.findDatasource('ds').save().then(() => app.toast('Saved'))}">
`}</code></pre>
    <h3>{`10. Declare All Dialogs in the Dialogs Container`}</h3>
    <p>{`Always wrap dialog components in a `}<inlineCode parentName="p">{`<dialogs>`}</inlineCode>{` element:`}</p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-xml"
      }}>{`<application id="myApp">
  <dialogs>
    <dialog id="dialog1" title="Dialog 1" />
    <lookup id="lookup1" datasource="ds1" />
    <sliding-drawer id="drawer1" header-text="Drawer" />
  </dialogs>
  
  <page id="mainPage">
    <!-- page content -->
  </page>
</application>
`}</code></pre>
    <hr></hr>
    <h2>{`Troubleshooting`}</h2>
    <h3>{`Issue: Component Won’t Close After Primary Action`}</h3>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Symptom:`}</strong>{` Clicking the primary button doesn’t close the component.`}</p>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Causes & Solutions:`}</strong></p>
    <ol>
      <li parentName="ol"><strong parentName="li">{`Validation returning false:`}</strong></li>
    </ol>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-javascript"
      }}>{`// Check your validate method
validate() {
  // Make sure this returns true when validation passes
  return this.isFormValid();
}
`}</code></pre>
    <ol {...{
      "start": 2
    }}>
      <li parentName="ol"><strong parentName="li">{`Primary action handler returning false:`}</strong></li>
    </ol>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-javascript"
      }}>{`// Ensure your handler returns true or undefined
onPrimaryAction() {
  this.saveData();
  return true; // Explicitly return true to close
}
`}</code></pre>
    <ol {...{
      "start": 3
    }}>
      <li parentName="ol"><strong parentName="li">{`Async operation not awaited:`}</strong></li>
    </ol>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-xml"
      }}>{`<!-- Add async-primary-action attribute -->
<dialog async-primary-action="true" on-primary-action="saveData">
`}</code></pre>

    <h3>{`Issue: Component State Not Updating UI`}</h3>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Symptom:`}</strong>{` Changing component state doesn’t update the displayed values.`}</p>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Solution:`}</strong>{` Ensure you’re using proper binding syntax:`}</p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-xml"
      }}>{`<!-- Correct - Use binding -->
<field value="{dialog.state.userName}" />

<!-- Incorrect - Static value -->
<field value="dialog.state.userName" />
`}</code></pre>
    <hr></hr>
    <h3>{`Issue: Controller Methods Not Being Called`}</h3>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Symptom:`}</strong>{` Lifecycle event handlers aren’t executing.`}</p>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Causes & Solutions:`}</strong></p>
    <ol>
      <li parentName="ol"><strong parentName="li">{`Controller not properly bound:`}</strong></li>
    </ol>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-xml"
      }}>{`<!-- Ensure controller attribute is set -->
<dialog id="myDialog" controller="MyDialogController">
`}</code></pre>
    <ol {...{
      "start": 2
    }}>
      <li parentName="ol"><strong parentName="li">{`Method name mismatch:`}</strong></li>
    </ol>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-javascript"
      }}>{`// Method name must match the event name
// For on-open-action="loadData"
loadData() { // Correct
  // ...
}

onLoadData() { // Incorrect - won't be called
  // ...
}
`}</code></pre>
    <ol {...{
      "start": 3
    }}>
      <li parentName="ol"><strong parentName="li">{`Controller file not exported:`}</strong></li>
    </ol>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-javascript"
      }}>{`// Ensure default export
export default class MyDialogController {
  // ...
}
`}</code></pre>

    <h3>{`Issue: Component Opens But Content Is Empty`}</h3>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Symptom:`}</strong>{` Component appears but shows no content.`}</p>

    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{

    await ds.load();
  }
}

    <ol {...{

    <h3>{`Issue: Lookup Not Showing Search Results`}</h3>

</dialog>

    <h3>{`Issue: Drill-Down Navigation Not Working`}</h3>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Symptom:`}</strong>{` Clicking on items doesn’t navigate to child records, or drill-in event doesn’t fire.`}</p>

</lookup-with-filter>
`}</code></pre>
    <ol {...{
      "start": 2
    }}>
      <li parentName="ol"><strong parentName="li"><inlineCode parentName="strong">{`on-drill-in`}</inlineCode>{` handler not loading data:`}</strong></li>
    </ol>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-javascript"
      }}>{`// ❌ Wrong - not loading data
handleDrillIn(item) {
  console.log('Drilling into:', item);
  // Missing datasource load!
}

// ✅ Correct - loads child data
async handleDrillIn(item) {
  const datasource = this.app.findDatasource('hierarchyDS');
  
  if (!item) {
    // Load root level
    await datasource.load({ qbe: { parent: null } });
  } else {
    // Load children
    await datasource.load({ qbe: { parent: item.id } });
  }
}
`}</code></pre>

}

  name: 'Parent Item',
  hasChildren: true,
  children: [] // or childCount: 5
}
`}</code></pre>
